faq: Are your invoices legally valid in my country?
Invoice rules differ by country. We include the fields you tell us are required, such as a tax number, but we are not tax advisers, so please check requirements with your accountant.
Can you set this up with an invoicing tool like Xero or QuickBooks?
Yes, in many cases through their official connections. Tell us which tool you use, and we confirm what is possible before the work starts.
Will past payments get invoices too?
New payments get them automatically. For older payments, your provider may let us generate documents after the fact. We tell you what is possible before starting.
Can customers add their company details?
In the Premium package, yes. Customers can add a company name and tax ID that then appear on every future invoice, and each invoice keeps a record of what they entered.
